efield.description: Coulomb's law made visible. Place point charges and watch field lines trace the combined electric field.

hatmonotile.description: A single aperiodic tile covers the plane without repeating. Change the substitution level and palette, then pan or zoom through the patch.

mohr.description: A four-dimensional hypercube rotates through several planes before two projections bring it onto the screen. Tap the field to cycle through the rotation modes.

turboquant.description: A vector quantization display compresses high-dimensional values through random rotation, angle bins, and one-bit sign coding. Adjust the dimensions and bit depth to compare reconstruction error with space saved.

faultlines.description: A pressure grid opens into branching fractures. Drag across the field to load new cells and watch the line follow the strain.

slipplanes.description: A sheared lattice releases strain along weak rows. Drag across the field to load the material and watch dislocations move through it.

erosiontable.description: A sediment table where water finds low ground, cuts channels, and leaves a record of flow. Drag across the field to pour new water into the loose grain.

dryingfront.description: A wet plate evaporates from its edges and leaves mineral bands where the boundary slows down. Drag across the field to add moisture and watch new rings form.

siltledger.description: Layered sediment bands record water, silt, and new cuts through the field. Drag to cut a channel and watch heavier grain settle into the marks.

salttide.description: Tidewater crosses a shallow salt pan, evaporates from the high edges, and leaves crystal ridges where the brine slows down. Drag across the field to pull a wet edge through the basin.

seepmap.description: Groundwater rises through a sand bed, darkens low channels, and leaves chalky seep lines where pressure gathers. Drag across the field to raise the water table and open new springs.
